name: my-country
description: Shows the country of your public IP as an uppercase ISO3 code (ESP, DEU, USA) at the left of the hint line under the prompt

home_country.title: Home country
home_country.description: Your country as a 3-letter ISO code, for example USA. The code shows green while your IP is in that country and red anywhere else. Leave it empty for no colors.

block_prompts_abroad.title: Block prompts when abroad
block_prompts_abroad.description: When on, pressing Enter does not send your prompt while the detected country differs from your home country (the red code). It is checked again at Enter, and a prompt is also held when the country cannot be confirmed (offline). Slash commands still work. Needs home_country.

check_every_seconds.title: Check every (seconds)
check_every_seconds.description: How often to look up the country of your IP. Default 60, minimum 2, maximum 3600.
